text.arabic_uthmani: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

words.gloss_range: disconnected interrogative particle launching a rebutting alternative
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:ʾam}}) opens the ayah as a challenge, not as a neutral request for information. Its disconnected interrogative force puts the whole oath proposition on trial before the proposition is fully stated: oaths, their reach, and their claimed content all fall under one rebutting question. Because the same challenge pattern belongs to the surrounding sequence (68:36-41), the particle also turns the prior entitlement claim (68:38) into cross-examination rather than beginning an isolated topic.

topics.headline: rhetorical alternative already under denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening question already treats the oath claim as untenable rather than genuinely possible.
topics.reason: The QAC particle tag and translation support license a rhetorical challenge, and the CRITICAL rows coherently extend that force over the full oath proposition.

topics.headline: challenge chain across the surrounding ayahs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this opening continues the surah's interrogative pressure, turning the claim of 68:38 into a legal-style challenge.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly relates the opening pattern to the nearby challenge refrain, so the boundary rows survive with concrete reference to 68:38 and 68:36-41.

topics.headline: bare particle as fresh hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a compact hinge that changes discourse mode before any noun appears.
topics.reason: The surface is an unprefixed particle at the head of the interrogative nominal clause, so the form-specific challenge beat is locally supported.

topics.headline: initial glottal sound
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound observation is decorative once the stronger grammatical and discourse challenge topics are retained.
topics.reason: No guardrail contradicts the sound note, but it adds no distinct reader-facing payoff beyond the retained opening-challenge topics.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām phrase marking possession, benefit, and addressed claimants
words.prose: The first {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) puts the addressees in the possession slot before the oath noun appears. Arabic makes this a nominal status claim, not an action report: the question is whether any such oaths exist for them at all. The bound suffix fixes the claimants as the challenged addressee group, while the repeated form later in the ayah makes their alleged benefit circle back from possessed oaths to possessed outcomes.

topics.headline: fronted possession predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah challenges possession as a standing legal status before naming the alleged proof.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the phrase as the possessive predicate paired with the delayed oath noun.

topics.headline: addressees bound to the benefit claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessors are not vague humans; the challenged group is grammatically fused to the claimed benefit.
topics.reason: The 2mp suffix is resolved to the direct addressees, and lām can carry possession and benefit in this local frame.

topics.headline: first half of the repeated benefit frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first benefit phrase is later echoed inside the quoted guarantee, exposing the circularity of the claim.
topics.reason: The same surface form recurs at word 10 under the content clause, so the repetition topic is structurally anchored.

topics.headline: nasal link to oath noun
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The acoustic note does not add a separate lexical or structural payoff beyond the retained possession relation.
topics.reason: The row is not contradicted, but it is too decorative to require reader-facing prose.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural oaths as alleged legal instruments
words.root_gloss_range: oath/right-hand field, with right-side authority and auspicious force narrowed locally to oath instruments
words.prose: {{ar:أَيْمَٰنٌ}} ({{tr:ʾaymānun}}) names not a known covenant but an unspecified class of oaths. Its indefinite plural form lets the challenge deny any such binding instruments, while its nominative role makes the oaths the delayed subject of the possession claim. The {{ar:ي م ن}} ({{tr:y-m-n}}) field contributes right-hand authority and pledge force, but the local sense remains oaths: alleged legal instruments that would somehow bind the divine speaker and guarantee whatever the addressees judge.

topics.headline: unspecified plural oath instruments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question challenges any class of oath at all, not one identifiable document or covenant.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite plural and the predicate relation makes it the entity whose existence is challenged.

topics.headline: delayed subject after claimant phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claimants are foregrounded before the alleged proof, making the proof arrive as secondary to their self-interest.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support delayed mubtadaʾ after a fronted prepositional predicate.

topics.headline: oath sense colored by right-hand authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath word carries embodied authority pressure, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as sworn pledges.
topics.reason: V4 supports oath and right-hand branches for the root, but the local plural noun is the oath instrument, not a literal hand.

topics.headline: oaths as devices for claimed verdict authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oaths are imagined as the instrument that would make the addressees' own judgments enforceable.
topics.reason: The inna clause is the content governed by the oath noun, and the final judgment verb discloses what the alleged oaths would guarantee.

topics.headline: oath noun between claimants and divine burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the word order stages an attempted transfer of obligation from the claimants to the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The oath noun is qualified by the burden phrase and by the following adjective, so its position in the legal-instrument beat is locally meaningful.

topics.headline: sound and broad oath-field notes
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The rows either repeat the retained indefiniteness and legal-instrument payoffs or add decorative sound detail.
topics.reason: The broader oath-field and sound rows are accounted for, but their usable payoff is already carried by the retained oath-instrument topics.

words.gloss_range: prepositional burden phrase: upon or against Us
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْنَا}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā}}) converts the claimed oaths into a burden aimed at the divine speaker. The movement from the earlier benefit phrase to this phrase changes the frame from benefit for them to obligation upon Us. Because the preposition can carry both burden and over-against force, the phrase makes the authority inversion concrete: human claimants imagine an oath standing over the One speaking.

topics.headline: from benefit for them to burden upon Us
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oath is not merely possessed by them; it is alleged to bind the divine speaker.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence qualifies the oath noun with this phrase as oaths binding upon Us.

topics.headline: first-person plural affected referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged obligation is directed at the speaker side, not at an impersonal legal system.
topics.reason: The 1cp suffix is resolved by the bundle as the divine speaker role.

topics.headline: obligation and over-against force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the preposition's hierarchy pressure: the alleged oath is imagined as bearing down over the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The local obligation frame licenses the burden sense, while the semantic pressure of over-against intensifies rather than replaces it.

topics.headline: entitlement becomes adversarial legal scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 68:39 sharpens the prior entitlement scene (68:38) into a claim directed against the divine speaker.
topics.reason: Boundary rows cohere with the local prepositional burden phrase and the prior claim in 68:38.

topics.headline: sound opens into the reaching word
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound arc repeats the movement-to-endpoint payoff better carried by the following participle and preposition.
topics.reason: The row is not needed for reader-facing prose after the burden and temporal movement topics are retained.

words.gloss_range: active participial adjective: reaching, arriving at, or becoming effective at an endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: reaching a limit is active locally; maturity, conveyance, and effective speech remain qualifying pressures
words.prose: {{ar:بَٰلِغَةٌ}} ({{tr:bālighatun}}) makes the supposed oaths travel toward an endpoint rather than merely sit as valid documents. In the base reading it is a nominative feminine adjective agreeing with the broken plural oath noun, so the oaths themselves carry the reaching property. The accepted accusative reading narrows this into a circumstantial state, but both readings preserve the same pressure: the alleged guarantee is imagined as reaching, maturing, and becoming effective all the way to the named Day.

topics.headline: oaths characterized as actively reaching
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the oaths are not static; their claimed validity is pictured as an active reach toward a terminus.
topics.reason: The active participle modifies the oath noun and governs the endpoint phrase through the following preposition.

topics.headline: nominative adjective and accusative circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a small case shift can recast the same reaching word as an inherent modifier or as the oaths' circumstantial state.
topics.reason: The canonical local parse is nominative adjective, while accepted variant evidence supports a circumstantial reading without replacing the base parse.

topics.headline: reaching, maturity, and effectiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reaching word can make the alleged oath sound like a pledge maturing at its due date and arriving with operative force.
topics.reason: V4 supports several b-l-gh branches, but the local Form I participle with endpoint selects reaching while allowing maturity and effectiveness as secondary pressure.

topics.headline: the oath itself reaches rather than delivers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the actual form assigns motion to the oath itself, not a causative act of delivering something to another.
topics.reason: The surface is Form I active participle, so delivery and conveyance are secondary root pressure rather than the selected form meaning.

topics.headline: second beat opens the duration claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah escalating from alleged instrument to how far that instrument supposedly reaches.
topics.reason: The participle begins the temporal-extent portion of the nominal clause and requires the following endpoint phrase for completion.

topics.headline: indefinite cadence and vowel stretch
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The acoustic and cadence rows add texture but no distinct payoff beyond the retained oath-adjective and endpoint topics.
topics.reason: The rows are accounted for as low-payoff sound observations after their structural content is retained elsewhere.

words.gloss_range: preposition of direction and temporal endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}) is the small hinge that turns the reaching adjective into a deadline. It governs the whole construct phrase after it, so the terminus is the Day of Resurrection rather than an isolated day-word. Its spatial sense of toward and temporal sense of until cooperate locally: the alleged oaths are pictured as moving toward, and lasting until, the final horizon. Compared with the present-tense entitlement claim in 68:38, this particle widens the claim into eschatological duration.

topics.headline: preposition governs the full endpoint phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle supplies the grammar of termination and makes the full Resurrection phrase the endpoint.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following day noun as governed by this preposition as endpoint complement.

topics.headline: toward becomes until
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that duration is expressed as motion toward a deadline, not as a flat date label.
topics.reason: The reaching participle before the preposition makes the directional and temporal values mutually reinforcing.

topics.headline: attachment to participle, with oath-duration pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint most directly completes the reaching participle, while the duration still qualifies the alleged oaths.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle syntactically forces the endpoint complement of the participle, so the looser attachment-to-oaths reading is kept only as duration pressure.

topics.headline: present entitlement widens to eschatological duration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the entitlement claim of 68:38 is expanded in 68:39 until the resurrection horizon.
topics.reason: The boundary row is concrete and coheres with the local endpoint construction.

topics.headline: open vowel link into endpoint

words.gloss_range: genitive construct head: Day as bounded endpoint and event-time
words.root_gloss_range: day, span, event-time, and marked occasion; locally specified as the Resurrection Day
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yawmi}}) is not a free adverbial date. It is genitive under the preceding endpoint preposition and construct-bound to the following Resurrection noun, so the ordinary word for day becomes a specified eschatological endpoint. Its semantic range can include a day, event-time, or era, but the local construct phrase makes it the known due date against which the alleged oaths are tested. In the surah's local day-thread, it stands between the day of action (68:24) and the exposed Day scene (68:42).

topics.headline: genitive endpoint governed by the preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Day is syntactically the limit of the oath's claimed reach, not just a time when something happens.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the noun as the endpoint complement governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: construct binds day to Resurrection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word waits for its genitive complement to become the known Resurrection Day.
topics.reason: The day noun is a construct head with no independent article or tanwīn, forcing completion by the following resurrection noun.

topics.headline: day, event-time, or reckoning era
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the time word can carry more than a calendar date, while the construct phrase narrows it to the decisive event-time.
topics.reason: V4 supports a broad yawm range, but the local idafa selects the Resurrection event as the relevant endpoint.

topics.headline: familiar formula made a contractual deadline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar Resurrection formula is recast as the impossible maturity date of the alleged guarantee.
topics.reason: The yawm-plus-qiyāma formula is strongly supported, and the local oath frame makes it function as a legal endpoint.

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references, so the local thread survives without becoming a governing parse.

topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound observation adds no distinct payoff beyond the retained construct-expansion topic.
topics.reason: The structural and formulaic topics carry the same expansion more concretely.

words.gloss_range: the known Resurrection as genitive complement of the Day phrase
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, and resurrection; locally the technical Resurrection event
words.prose: {{ar:الْقِيَامَةِ}} ({{tr:al-qiyāmati}}) specifies the day by the known Resurrection. The article and idafa relation double-anchor the phrase: the oaths are measured not against an indefinite future but against the recognized event where standing and judgment are reconstituted. The root's rising and standing image remains useful, but it is narrowed by the proper-noun-like form to the technical eschatological endpoint. Here the familiar accountability formula becomes a legal deadline before the Day is dramatized as exposure in 68:42.

topics.headline: known Resurrection specifies the Day
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is presupposed and identifiable, not an undefined future occasion.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and functions as the genitive complement that specifies the construct head.

topics.headline: day named by the event that defines it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase names time by the resurrection event itself, not by a mere calendar endpoint.
topics.reason: The genitive complement packages the event as the defining label of the day.

topics.headline: rising and standing behind the technical term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the technical Resurrection term still carries the concrete image of universal rising and standing for judgment.
topics.reason: V4 supports standing and resurrection branches, but the local proper-noun form selects the technical event rather than generic standing.

topics.headline: Resurrection horizon opposes self-judgment

topics.reason: The local sequence places the Resurrection endpoint before the final judgment verb, making the contrast coherent.

topics.headline: familiar formula before the exposed Day scene

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah reference to 68:42 and a familiar formulaic setting.

topics.headline: specialized event noun, not generic standing derivative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected form fixes the endpoint as the recognized Resurrection event rather than a generic act of standing or establishing.
topics.reason: The noun belongs to the specialized qiyāma form group, so alternative q-w-m derivatives are excluded from the local parse.

topics.headline: acoustic framing of the title
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The sound rows are decorative after the definite-title and specialized-form topics are retained.
topics.reason: They do not add a separate lexical or structural insight.

words.gloss_range: assertive particle introducing the alleged oath-content clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}) begins the quoted content of the supposed oath, not a fresh divine endorsement. Under the outer challenge, its normal assertive force becomes ironic: the alleged guarantee is stated in emphatic syntax precisely so it can be exposed. Variant readings with interrogative or subordinating force show the pressure point at the start of the content clause, but the local frame still keeps the clause governed by the oath claim.

topics.headline: assertive particle inside challenged oath content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the emphatic assertion is quoted as their alleged guarantee and is not endorsed by the surrounding question.
topics.reason: The attachment bundle marks the inna clause as content governed by the oath noun, within the outer interrogative challenge.

topics.headline: fronted predicate and delayed relative content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the content clause repeats entitlement grammar: benefit comes first, then the relative object of judgment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies word 10 as the khabar and word 11 as the ism/content element of the clause.

topics.headline: assertion questioned or subordinated in variants

topics.reason: Accepted variants may illustrate formal pressure, while the canonical local parse remains the assertive content clause under the oath frame.

topics.headline: assertion stacked with the following emphatic lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is grammatically over-confirmed, which makes its self-certainty part of the rebuke.
topics.reason: The clause contains the assertive particle and the following emphatic lām in the relative element, matching the CRITICAL emphasis topic.

topics.headline: hamza and length variants at the content onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational variation concentrates exactly where the alleged assertion begins.
topics.reason: The variant sound data is useful as apparatus, but it does not govern the canonical local syntax.

words.gloss_range: fronted predicate in the content clause: assigned benefit for the addressees
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) repeats the same addressee-benefit form inside the alleged guarantee. Here it is the fronted predicate of the emphatic content clause: before the clause names what is judged, it announces that the outcome is for them. This recurrence makes the ayah's circular claim audible: do you have oaths, and do those oaths say that you have whatever you judge? Its compact bound form keeps attention on the entitlement relation rather than separately foregrounding the people.

topics.headline: same addressees through the content clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessors, beneficiaries, and judges are the same addressed group.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence resolves the suffix to the direct addressees, matching word 2 and the final verb.

topics.headline: fronted predicate before relative content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that entitlement is grammatically announced before the unrestricted object of judgment is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies this phrase as the khabar of the content clause before the relative element.

topics.headline: judged output assigned to them

topics.reason: The second lām phrase functions as beneficiary/allocation predicate within the quoted guarantee.

topics.headline: repeated benefit phrase exposes circularity

topics.headline: compact relation over independent pronoun emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form keeps attention on the entitlement relation rather than separately foregrounding the people.
topics.reason: The compact fused preposition-plus-suffix form is repeated and remains relation-focused.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām plus relative mā: assuredly whatever
words.root_gloss_range: particle construction is active locally; gathering and minor-fault associations are narrowed to secondary pressure
words.prose: {{ar:لَمَا}} ({{tr:lamā}}) fuses emphasis with an unrestricted relative object. The emphatic lām stacks with the preceding assertive particle, while the mā waits for the following judgment verb to define whatever is being claimed. The surface is a particle construction, not the noun for minor faults; still, the {{ar:ل م م}} ({{tr:l-m-m}}) field of gathering can sharpen the image of every judged outcome compressed into one overconfident claim. Its adjacent echo with 68:38 changes the governing verb from choosing to judging, escalating appetite into authority.

topics.headline: emphasis fused to whatever
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that confirmation and unrestricted content arrive together in a single load-bearing word.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence analyze the form as emphatic lām plus relative mā, with mā as the content element of the clause.

topics.headline: relative object completed by the final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word opens an unrestricted domain and forces the final verb to define it.
topics.reason: The relative clause relation is syntactically forced, and the final verb takes the mā element as its object within that construction.

topics.headline: stacked confirmation becomes ridicule

topics.reason: The emphatic lām and the surrounding question make the claim's self-certainty reader-facing.

topics.reason: V4 supports gathering and minor-fault branches, but QAC and attachment evidence make the local surface a grammatical particle construction rather than a lexical noun.

words.gloss_range: imperfect indicative second-person plural: you judge, rule, decide, or determine
words.root_gloss_range: judging and ruling are active locally; restraint, wisdom, and firmness remain qualifying root pressures
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْكُمُونَ}} ({{tr:taḥkumūna}}) closes the ayah on the addressees' own act of judging. Its imperfect indicative form keeps the claim open-ended and asserted within the quoted guarantee, while its second-person plural ending supplies the same group already marked by both benefit phrases. The verb completes the prior relative object, so the supposed oath guarantees whatever they keep deciding. The {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) root can evoke restraint, adjudication, wisdom, and firmness, but the local Form I verb makes them the judges, not litigants or appointers of a judge; that is why the ayah lands on self-authorized judgment under the Resurrection horizon. It also turns 68:38's choosing claim into a judging claim and leaves the unsupported verdict ready for the guarantor demand in 68:40.

topics.headline: ongoing addressed judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim is not a completed past verdict but whatever the addressed group keeps judging.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support imperfect indicative 2mp with the addressees as implicit subject.

topics.headline: final verb defines the whatever

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ayman, balighah, ila yawm al-qiyamah, and lakum lama tahkumun links an oath, its temporal reach, and the addressees' judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sworn pledge functions as title: it must originate against Us, remain effective to the terminal event, and guarantee the claimants whatever verdict they award themselves. The question exposes the extraordinary chain of authority required by their conclusion.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch supplies a sworn pledge and makes it the alleged legal title for the promised outcome.
Reaching a limit gives the alleged pledge continuity all the way to its stated terminus.
The event-day branch makes the endpoint a consequential occasion rather than a neutral calendar date.
Resurrection and standing before the Lord identify the terminal occasion at which the title would have to remain valid.
Adjudication supplies the self-awarded verdict that the alleged oath is asked to guarantee.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about promises that let the addressees have what they want.
changed_reading.after: A demand for the sworn title under which the claimants could bind God through resurrection to honor their own verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional polarity lakum, alayna and the final tahkumun can stage a transfer of authority from Us to you.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alleged oaths are read as a delegation of rightful force. To support the conclusion, that delegation would have to be fully effective and place unrestricted disposal of outcomes in the addressees' hands.

activation_trace.role: Right-hand power and rightful force turn the alleged oath into an instrument of authority.
Complete, non-deficient force makes the supposed authorization total rather than partial.
Delegation and entrusted decision supply the precise authority that the addressees would need for whatever they decide to become theirs.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies a favorable promise.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks whether God ever delegated open-ended disposal, exposing the missing jurisdiction behind the favorable claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Balighah ila yawm gives the oath a movement toward a dated endpoint, while qiyamah and tahkumun supply standing and decisiveness there.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath behaves like a term instrument: issued now, carried across an open span, and alleged to mature into a firm judgment when creatures stand. This differs from mere duration because the endpoint is where the claim becomes executable.

activation_trace.role: The sworn pledge supplies the instrument whose future performance is in question.
Arrival at a measured endpoint turns duration into maturity at a term.
An open span of time supplies the interval across which the instrument allegedly remains alive.
The resurrection standing supplies the maturity event rather than merely naming a distant future.
Firmness and decisiveness make the alleged benefit executable at maturity.

changed_reading.before: The oath simply lasts until the Resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The oath is imagined as maturing at the Resurrection into an executable entitlement to the claimants' chosen result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ayman, balighah, and tahkumun can activate a hand-rein-bridle mechanism while remaining attached to words 3, 5, and 12.
baseline_models.mechanism: Right-hand force grips, the horseman extends the rein to accelerate, and the bridle checks motion. Together they form a sarcastic control image: the addressees would need to hold the reins of the divine commitment, releasing or restraining outcomes to match their judgment.

activation_trace.role: The right hand as power supplies the controlling grip in the image.
The horseman extending the reins to increase speed supplies the releasing motion of control.
The restraining bridle supplies the opposite checking motion and turns judgment into imagined control of the course.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely choose an outcome.
changed_reading.after: The question briefly pictures them as holding divine reins, able to accelerate or check outcomes until reality follows their choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of habitual oath-making with abasement removes evidentiary weight from oath abundance. The focus therefore does not ask whether the addressees can produce many oaths, but whether any oath truly issued from God and binds Him.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath is the alleged title whose credibility is being tested.
Literal oath-taking supplies the earlier image of oath proliferation and weakens quantity as proof.
Lowliness and weakness attach discredit to the habitual oath-maker, sharpening the provenance test in the focus.

structural_cues: The discredited oath-maker appears before the focus asks for oaths that are specifically alayna, against Us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath-taking joined to abasement and a later demand for oaths from Us; I infer that the first scene discounts merely human oath volume, while the live alternative is that it only characterizes one opponent.

changed_reading.before: Possession of emphatic oaths could itself establish the claim.
changed_reading.after: Oaths are cheap unless their divine provenance and binding direction can be shown; plurality intensifies the challenge rather than the proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners convert a self-sworn plan, exclusion of the poor, and felt capacity into an imagined entitlement to the crop. Their failed oath becomes a concrete counterfeit of the focus oath: human resolve cannot create an obligation upon God or guarantee what its makers decide.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath supplies the alleged divine title that the garden oath counterfeits.
Entrusted disposal names the authority the owners assume without actually receiving it.
An oath apportioned among its parties supplies the owners' mutually reinforced plan.
The abasement of poverty identifies the vulnerable person whom their asserted entitlement excludes.
Prevention and contraction supply the exclusionary purpose carried by the oath.
Effective capacity supplies the owners' confidence that intention can force the result.

structural_cues: The garden sequence moves from swearing to covert exclusion to confident execution and then immediate loss.
The garden oath is made by the owners, whereas 68:39 demands an oath whose liability lies upon Us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the owners' oath, exclusionary aim, and confidence followed by failure; I infer that this enacted failure tests the same authority claim as 68:39, while an alternative is that it serves only as a moral analogy rather than a direct legal parallel.

changed_reading.before: The focus challenges an abstract claim to a favorable future.
changed_reading.after: The focus challenges the exact mistake enacted by the garden owners: treating one's oath-backed decision as power over a result that remains God's to give.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disputed judgment is not undefined preference. It would make the submitted and the culpable share one outcome, collapsing a moral distinction by fiat. The alleged oath is thus the missing authority for an act of category equalization.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication anchors the addressees' choice as a verdict about differentiated classes.
The oath is the alleged warrant needed to make that verdict binding.
Making something enter a state supplies the proposed operation of rendering two classes alike.
Freedom from defect marks one side of the distinction the judgment would erase.
Culpability and offense mark the opposed class and make equal treatment a substantive verdict.
The immediately preceding act of adjudication identifies the focus repetition as continued cross-examination of that verdict.

structural_cues: 68:35 poses the class comparison, 68:36 challenges how they judge, and 68:39 repeats the judgment clause after testing possible warrants.
The branchless k-y-f interrogative in 68:36 intensifies scrutiny of method but supplies no branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two contrasted classes, an act of making, and repeated judgment language; I infer that the focus oath would have to authorize their equalization, while the alternative is a broader challenge to any self-favoring eschatological verdict.

changed_reading.before: Whatever you judge means any preferred reward.
changed_reading.after: Whatever you judge is the attempted fiat by which moral categories are flattened and the favorable class assignment is guaranteed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence tests two forms of title in turn: a written enactment that can be studied and an oath binding upon God. Both would have to contain the same implausible clause granting the claimants whatever they select.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the second alleged instrument of title after the written one.
Reaching the limit makes the oral instrument as durable as the claimed written rule.
A written enactment that imposes judgment or decree supplies the first possible documentary title.
Following a text through reading and memorization supplies the means by which its alleged clause would be verified.
Choosing among goods supplies the beneficiary-controlled option that both alleged instruments would guarantee.

structural_cues: The parallel clauses in 68:38 and 68:39 repeat lakum and lama around two different proposed warrants: a book and oaths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a studied book, beneficiary choice, and then enduring oaths; I infer a documentary-versus-sworn evidentiary ladder, while the alternative is simple rhetorical accumulation without technical instrument contrast.

changed_reading.before: The book and the oaths are separate rhetorical impossibilities.
changed_reading.after: They are alternative instruments offered for inspection, each supposedly carrying the same beneficiary-written entitlement clause.

context_deltas.mechanism: After asking for the instrument, the discourse asks for its human guarantor and associated parties, then tests performance against truth. The focus becomes one stage in a burden-of-proof ladder: instrument, responsible underwriter, co-parties, production, verification.

activation_trace.role: The sworn pledge supplies the instrument whose backing must be demonstrated.
Adjudication supplies the favorable result for which proof and backing are demanded.

structural_cues: 68:40-41 follow the focus by demanding first a responsible person and then the alleged partners themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarantee, partnership, appearance, and truth-performance after the oath question; I infer a procedural escalation of proof, while the alternative is a sequence of independent challenges to different beliefs.

changed_reading.before: 68:39 asks only whether a promise exists.
changed_reading.after: 68:39 is the instrument-production stage of a hearing that next demands an underwriter and co-parties able to perform the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named Day is where covering is removed, parties are summoned, and embodied compliance is attempted but unavailable. Thus an oath reaching the Day is not merely unexpired; it reaches a performance hearing where entitlement is tested against capacity to answer the call.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at the endpoint carries the alleged oath into the later performance scene.

Resurrection standing locates the proceeding in the focus construction.
Removal of a covering supplies disclosure at the alleged instrument's maturity.
A verbal summons supplies the call to perform rather than merely receive a benefit.
Submission and lowering supply the demanded performance that tests their posture.
Capacity to perform supplies the decisive failure: they cannot do what the summons requires.

structural_cues: The focus's ila yawm is answered three verses later by yawm followed by disclosure, summons, demanded action, and inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a term reaching the Day and then a failed summoned performance; I infer that the Day functions like a maturity hearing, while the alternative is that the later scene only specifies the Day without extending the legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The oath would remain valid until a distant deadline.
changed_reading.after: The oath would have to survive disclosure and a performance hearing at which its supposed beneficiaries cannot answer the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gradual taking, extended time, and a solid counter-plan reverse the apparent value of an oath lasting to the Day. Long duration is not durable privilege; it can be the runway along which concealed enforcement advances degree by degree until it reaches its target.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint anchors the later gradual process as an alternative account of what duration accomplishes.
An open span of time supplies the interval that can be mistaken for favor.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the hidden forward process operating during delay.
Extension of time supplies apparent respite and the temporal medium of enforcement.
A concealed plan supplies the reversal by which respite serves an outcome opposite to the claimants' expectation.
Extended solidity makes the counter-plan, not the alleged oath, the truly durable force.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 place imperceptible progression and granted time immediately after the Day scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise taking, temporal extension, concealed planning, and solidity; I infer the arrow from respite to eventual enforcement, while the alternative is that these verses threaten present deniers without specifically reinterpreting the focus term.

changed_reading.before: Length to the Day would prove the permanence of the claimants' privilege.
changed_reading.after: Length can conceal an opposing process: the interval itself carries firm enforcement toward them rather than carrying their entitlement for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's lakum and alayna polarity reads like creditor and obligor language. The following wage, attached debt, burden, hidden account, and writing cues expose the claim as an imaginary ledger in which God owes an unlimited credit entered by the beneficiaries' own judgment.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the alleged obligation entered against Us.
Open disposal lets the supposed creditors set the size and kind of their own credit.
Compensation for work supplies the neighboring question of whether any payment is actually due.
A financial liability that adheres supplies the debt relation implicit in putting an oath alayna.
A load made heavy supplies the felt burden of the alleged liability.
Concealment from sight supplies the inaccessible ledger from which the claimants pretend to know the balance.
Writing that establishes a binding judgment supplies the imagined entry that would prove the debt.

structural_cues: The pronoun alignment of for you and upon Us in 68:39 is followed by questions about wage, financial burden, access to the unseen, and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation-like prepositions followed by wage, debt, burden, hidden knowledge, and writing; I infer a creditor-ledger mechanism, while the alternative is that the financial and unseen questions independently test the messenger and the deniers.

changed_reading.before: The addressees claim a promise of favorable treatment.
changed_reading.after: They act as self-authorized creditors, alleging that God carries a debt whose unlimited balance they themselves enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command assigns judgment to your Lord and requires the messenger to remain restrained before it. This answers the focus's imagined delegation: tahkumun does not name valid jurisdiction but the addressees' attempted occupation of the Lord's decision seat.

activation_trace.role: Delegated decision names the authority whose existence the focus hypothetically tests.
Rightful force supplies the authority the addressees claim to possess.
Holding the self back from agitation supplies the proper human posture before judgment.
Adjudication reappears explicitly as the judgment belonging to the Lord.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the actual holder of adjudicative jurisdiction.

structural_cues: Tahkumun in 68:39 is later answered by li-hukmi rabbika in 68:48, reversing the possessor of judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same judgment root first with the addressees and later with the sovereign Lord, plus a command of restraint; I infer a jurisdictional correction, while the alternative is that the later phrase concerns only the timing of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely rejects the outcome the addressees selected.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects their jurisdiction to select it: judgment is the Lord's, and even His messenger waits under it rather than scripting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A real favorable reversal occurs when grace catches up before punitive casting and is followed by divine selection. This supplies a rival causal chain to the alleged oath: benefit comes by an overtaking gift and the Lord's choice, not by a beneficiary-controlled entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint anchors the question of which force arrives in time to determine the result.

structural_cues: The conditional rescue in 68:49 precedes the Lord's act of choosing in 68:50; the beneficiary does not dictate either act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grace overtaking before expulsion and then divine selection; I infer this as a rival causal model to sworn entitlement, while the alternative is that the narrative only illustrates mercy to one earlier figure.

changed_reading.before: A favorable future must be secured by a binding oath possessed by the beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: The context's actual favorable reversal is unowned grace that arrives in time and is completed by the Lord's choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing at the opening, the studied book near the focus, and the closing reminder create a transmission frame. In it, balighah can ask not only how long the oaths bind but through what attested channel any divine pledge ever reached the claimants.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message turns the focus adjective into a provenance and delivery test alongside its durative force.

structural_cues: The surah opens with pen and writing, places a studied book directly before 68:39, and closes with the Reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing media, written lines, a nearby book, a document-of-right branch, and the focus's delivery branch; I infer a chain-of-transmission test, while the alternative is that balighah only intensifies or extends the oaths.

changed_reading.after: Balighah also presses provenance: where is the attested communication by which such a divine oath ever reached them?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dying-on-the-right branch is remote from the ordinary oath sense of ayman. It remains valid as a secondary activation because death and resurrection are anchored in two explicit focus roots; downstream prose should present it only as a mortality-colored echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ayman at word 3 can carry the rare image of death marked by laying on the right side, while qiyamah at word 8 names rising again.

activation_trace.role: Dying as being laid on the right side supplies a mortality horizon inside the oath word.
Resurrection and rising supply the far side of that mortality horizon.

changed_reading.before: The oaths cross an abstract interval ending at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pledges are tested across the claimants' own death and rising: do they possess any guarantee that survives being laid down and stood up again?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qiyamah conventionally activates resurrection, not pricing, and the accounting network is cross-domain. It remains anchored in the focus's q-w-m valuation branch and h-k-m adjudication, with explicit wage, debt, and weight cues nearby; downstream prose should call it an accounting overlay on final judgment, not an alternative name for the Day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qiyamah at word 8 shares the q-w-m inventory with valuation and exact measure, and tahkumun at word 12 supplies adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Value, appraisal, and pricing supply an accounting color to the final standing.
Exact weight and even measure supply the standard against which self-valuation is tested.
Adjudication turns valuation into a consequential final award.
Wage or compensation supplies the neighboring question of what payment is due.
Attached financial liability supplies the debit side of the valuation scene.
Measured weight supplies the material analogy for exact accounting.

changed_reading.before: The Day is only when the addressees' preferred verdict would take effect.
changed_reading.after: As an accounting overlay, it is the final valuation where they absurdly claim both to set their own worth and to dictate the award.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later hearing idiom does not syntactically redefine balighah in 68:39. It remains unusually well anchored because the focus b-l-gh inventory itself contains the unwelcome-report branch and the later s-m-a inventory explicitly contains hearing without reaching; downstream prose should render it as a closing lexical counterpoint about reception and effect.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Balighah at word 5 carries a branch in which unwelcome news may be heard yet not reach completion.

activation_trace.role: An unwelcome report that is heard but does not reach completion supplies the focus-side half of the reception contrast.
The explicit hearing-without-reaching idiom supplies the later lexical reversal: sound arrives while effect or completion does not.
Bringing something to mind supplies the content heard and resisted at the close.

changed_reading.before: Balighah describes only an oath whose legal force reaches a remote date.
changed_reading.after: As a lexical counterpoint, the verse asks what truly reaches its end or effect: their alleged oath, or the Reminder they hear without allowing it to reach understanding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sufficient provision is a branch of b-l-gh rather than the normal adjective sense in the focus. It remains anchored in balighah and is activated by the surah's harvest, wealth, poverty, and wage economy; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for reliance, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Balighah at word 5 can activate the provision by which one gets through a span, here explicitly extending to the Day.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient provision supplies the image of an oath treated as rations that carry its possessor through time.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies the material confidence behind treating status as stored provision.
Earning and gathering supply the garden economy from which imagined self-sufficiency is drawn.
Wage and compensation supply a later test of whether material support is actually being exacted.

changed_reading.before: The oath is a legal guarantee lasting until the Day.
changed_reading.after: Materially, the claimants treat the alleged oath as inexhaustible provision that will carry their chosen privilege all the way to the Day.

strongest_changes: The garden owners' failed oath turns the focus from abstract denial into a tested counterfeit of divine obligation.
The book-oath-guarantor sequence reads as a procedural burden-of-proof ladder for an alleged entitlement.
The Day becomes a maturity and performance hearing, while gradual taking reverses long delay from privilege into deferred enforcement.
The wage-debt-writing sequence exposes lakum and alayna as an imaginary creditor ledger authored by its supposed beneficiaries.
The later judgment of your Lord resolves the focus as a contest over jurisdiction, not merely over the chosen result.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms from the same compact syntax: sworn title, delegated disposal, term maturity, procedural proof, debt accounting, and even a hand-rein-bridle control image. Context repeatedly changed who writes, guarantees, performs, values, and finally owns the judgment without forcing those readings into one compromise.
remaining_uncertainties: Balighah can support durability, arrival at maturity, complete force, or transmission provenance; the focus grammar does not select only one branch image.
The reins-control, mortuary, provision, and valuation activations are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should stay exploratory.
The procedural and accounting sequences are abductive readings of ordered cues, not explicit technical labels supplied by the packet.
The later Lord-judgment strongly reverses jurisdiction, but it may address timing and endurance as well as ownership of judgment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **An oath imagined to reach the final event.** `ي م ن B003` supplies sworn pledges, `ب ل غ B001` reaching an endpoint, `ي و م B003` an event-day, `ق و م B013` resurrection, and `ح ك م B002` judgment. The oath is tested by its supposed extension *to* that day. I infer only an obligation that remains binding across the endpoint could secure their claim; the question exposes the absence of such a guarantee.
2. **Powerful right hand converted into entitlement.** `ي م ن B004` supplies right-hand power and restraint, while `ح ك م B005` supplies delegated decision. The possessive repetitions imagine that their power can place an obligation “upon Us” and delegate to them whatever they judge. I infer human capacity is being inflated into authority over outcome; the ayah separates having power to swear from having power to bind the final adjudicator.
3. **An oath's eloquence must reach its intent.** `ب ل غ B004/B005` supplies speech reaching its intended effect and complete force. The earlier `ح ل ف B001/B002` showed oath inflation and degraded binding. I infer a true oath must do more than sound emphatic: it must possess a valid obligor and endpoint. *Bālighah* therefore tests legal efficacy as well as duration.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:42 immediately supplies the event-day to which the alleged oath would need to reach, but depicts a call and failed capacity rather than guaranteed preference. 68:45's firm delayed stratagem further undermines the assumption that present respite functions as a binding promise of final outcome.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **An imagined pledge whose force reaches the final rising.** Fixed `أَيْمَان` activates `ي م ن B003` (oath by the right hand) and `ي م ن B004` (the right hand as power), fixed `بَالِغَة` activates `ب ل غ B001` (reaching a limit), and fixed `ٱلْقِيَامَة` activates `ق و م B013` (resurrection). The book and choice in 68:37-38 and guarantor/partners in 68:40-41 supply a legal chain; I infer that they imagine a pledge powerful enough to carry their preferred judgment intact to the final endpoint. The question tests both duration and enforceability.
2. **A claim that cannot complete its own transmission.** Exploratorily, fixed `بَالِغَة` activates `ب ل غ B009` (an unwelcome report heard but not allowed to reach completion). The succeeding demands for a guarantor and partners, followed by failed capacity in 68:42, supply broken conveyance; I infer that their asserted oath is a report unable to reach the authority or performance that would ratify it. This branch reverses “far-reaching”: the claim is voiced but does not arrive.
3. **Judgment again lacks delegated ownership.** Fixed `تَحْكُمُونَ` activates `ح ك م B005` (delegated decision). The repeated possessive `لَكُمْ` and absent external warrant supply appropriation without commission; I infer that they have converted a delegated function into personal property. The ending reads as an exposure of unauthorized jurisdiction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:40-42 breaks the imagined transmission chain: no guarantor or partner arrives, and capacity fails at the embodied summons. This later nonarrival activated the reversal in fixed `بَالِغَة` through `ب ل غ B009`, a report heard but not brought to completion.

baseline.text: Yoksa üzerimizde sizin için kıyamet gününe kadar geçerli yeminler mi var; hükmettiğiniz ne varsa kesinlikle sizin olacak diye?

findings.text: Yeminin son hükmü verecek olanı bağlayacak geçerli güce sahip olduğu varsayılır; soru, insanın yemin etme gücü ile nihai sonucu belirleme yetkisini birbirinden ayırır.
İddia edilen yeminin sözü duyulsa da onu onaylayacak kefile ve gerçekleşmeye ulaşamaması, erişim iddiasını kendi içinde boşa çıkarır.
Kendilerine verilmemiş hüküm yetkisini mülkleriymiş gibi sahiplenmeleri, kişisel tercihi son yargı üzerinde yetkisiz bir yönetime çevirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Claims Become Durable Through Text, Judgment, and Guarantee
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claim acquires force when it is assembled into a durable record, interpreted under judgment, and backed by a responsible party.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The polemical questions expose a complete documentary institution: material joining, written decree, study, scope, oath, guarantor, partner, fulfillment, and adjudication.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Judgment Restrains Error and Brings a Matter to Firmness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A judge restrains disorder, identifies the right, issues a decision, and makes the resulting matter firm enough to hold.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: restraint for correction (`quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`); adjudication (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); right-discerning wisdom (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); firm and perfected decision (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); delegated arbitration (`quranic:root_000348:B005/m01`); restraining bridle (`quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`); quality carried to its limit (`quranic:root_000151:B005/m01`); established sound standing (`quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Judgment is neither preference nor naked command. It combines corrective restraint, knowledge, delegation, completion, and firmness; the bridle supplies a concrete image for preventing a claim from running wherever desire takes it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Oath, Guarantor, Partner, and Fulfillment Back the Claim
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sworn undertaking invokes power, a guarantor assumes liability, partners share the interest, and truthful action fulfills what speech pledged.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sworn oath (`quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`); oath as power and right (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); uncertain assertion (`quranic:root_000633:B001/m01`); guarantor (`quranic:root_000633:B003/m01`); leader speaking for a group (`quranic:root_000633:B004/m01`); shared interest (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); false divine partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); truthful statement (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); action fulfilling promise (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); oath-binding (`quranic:root_000076:B007/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:39 `أَيْمَٰنٌ` [ي م ن]; 68:40 `زَعِيمٌ` [ز ع م]; 68:41 `شُرَكَآءُ` [ش ر ك] and `صَٰدِقِينَ` [ص د ق]; surface anchor unavailable for root `ء ل ي`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These are separate support roles. Oath binds the speaker, guarantor absorbs failure, partner shares the claim, and fulfillment tests speech against action. The questions strip away each possible backing in turn.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] Obligation Acquires Weight, Price, and Market Form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A social or verbal demand becomes tangible when it attaches as debt, is measured as weight, or enters exchange as a price.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The rejected fee is surrounded by a full political economy of wages, debtors, standards, levies, markets, advance payment, charity, and emancipation installments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Weight and Valuation Make Burden Comparable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A burden is placed on a scale, assigned a standard weight or price, and judged heavy, precious, slow, or equal.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: physical and figurative heaviness (`quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`); standard weight (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`); precious weighty object (`quranic:root_000202:B005/m01`); heaviness producing slowness (`quranic:root_000202:B006/m01`); hearing made unreceptive by weight (`quranic:root_000202:B009/m01`); pricing and valuation (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); equal standard weight (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); active market (`quranic:root_001273:B018/m01`); ounce as measured weight (`quranic:root_001677:B004/m01`); threshing as measured processing (`quranic:root_000470:B005/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Weight converts an attaching obligation into something comparable. The branches distinguish mass, standard, price, preciousness, delay, and impaired reception, showing how “burdened” can describe both economic pressure and a listener’s slowed response.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P3 68:34-52] The Body Must Be Able to Stand, Bend, and Obey

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Failure to prostrate is rendered as a breakdown across posture, limb, gaze, footing, tractability, and jointed capacity, not simply unwillingness at the final moment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Standing and Prostration Form a Postural Sequence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A standing body receives the summons, lowers head and articulated limbs, places marked contact points, and completes prostration.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Prostration is a sequence of controlled articulations. Standing, summons, flexion, contact, and gaze must coordinate; the resurrection sense makes the inability especially stark because bodies have been raised but cannot complete the answering posture.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı uğur, iyilik artışı ve mutluluk getiren nitelik ile bir kişi, nesne ya da görüşten böyle bir sonuç umma eylemi çevresinde açıkça kurar. Sağ tarafı bildiren kimi ifadelerin iyi yazgı ve mutluluk için mecazlaşması da aynı olumlu değer çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sağ elin veya sağ yönün kendisini değil, bunlara ancak uğur ve mutluluk değeri yüklendiği kullanımları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın uğur ve iyilik getirme anlamını kalıba bağlı iyilik umma ve iyi yazgı kullanımlarından ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimse, şey, görüş ya da işarette bulunan ve iyilik, bolluk ya da mutluluk getiren olumlu niteliktir. Bir kişi, nesne veya görüşten bu niteliğe bağlı olarak iyilik umma da dala bağlı kullanımdır; sağ tarafla ilgili kimi kalıplar yalnız mutluluk, iyi yazgı veya Tanrı'ya yakınlık çağrışımı taşıdıklarında bu dala girer.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin çevresine iyilik, bolluk ve mutluluk getiren olumlu niteliği.
Bir kişi, nesne ya da görüşü olumlu sonuç getirecek sayarak ondan iyilik umma eylemi.
Sağ tarafı bildiren kimi sözlerin mutluluk, iyi yazgı ve Tanrı'ya yakınlık için mecazlaşması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uğur ve iyilik getiren niteliği, bu niteliğe sahip kişiyi ve bir kişi ya da görüşten olumlu sonuç umma eylemini aynı anlam alanında birleştirir; sağ taraf söylemi de mutluluk ve iyi yazgıya aktarılabilir.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya başka bir varlıktaki sağ el ya da bedenin sağ yanı ile bu yana karşılık gelen yön. Sağa ilerleme, bir topluluğu sağa götürme ve sağ elle verme gibi kullanımlar bu somut organ-yön çekirdeğine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: İnsanın ya da başka bir varlığın sağ eli veya sağ taraftaki bedensel yanı.

Sağa doğru ilerleme, başkalarını sağa götürme veya bir şeyi sağ elle verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sağ eli temel bedensel anlam, sağ tarafı da bunun yönsel karşılığı olarak birleştirir; sağa yönelme ve sağ elle yapılan verme eylemleri bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

Tanrı adıyla kurulan kalıplar bu alanın belirli biçimleridir; el anlamından aktarılmış olması tarihsel açıklamadır, dalın güncel çekirdeği söz güvencesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir genel sahiplik anlamı değil, iki ayrı sınırlı kullanım verir: konuşanla arasında antlaşma bulunan kişi ve konuşanın kesin sahiplik ile tasarrufunu bildiren söz. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek miktarı veya aracı ve kişinin elindekiyle yetinmesini birlikte destekler. Buradaki yeterlik, ileti ulaştırmaktan ayrı bir geçim ve yetme alanıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek ölçü ve araçla sınırlıdır; bolluk veya kazanç edinme süreci değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeterlik bildiren adlar ile eldeki geçim aracıyla yetinme kalıbı ayrıştırılır; kalıp yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuda yeterli olma veya ihtiyacı karşılayacak ölçüde bulunma. Geçimlik, yiyecek ya da azık ve eldekiyle yetinme bu genel yeterlik çekirdeğinin özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir konuda veya gereksinim karşısında yeterli olma temel anlamdır.
Yiyecek, azık ve öteki geçim araçları somut yeterlik biçimleridir.
Kişi elindeki yeterli şeyle yetinir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yeterli ölçü, yaşamı sürdüren yiyecek veya geçim aracı ve bunlarla yetinme kullanımlarını aynı geçim çekirdeği altında toplar.

concept_gloss.text: yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek ölçü ve geçim aracı
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem soyut yeterlik ölçüsünü hem de yiyecek gibi somut geçim aracını kapsar; yetinme kullanımı bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yeterli ölçüyü, geçim aracını ve onunla yetinme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yaşamı sürdürmeye yarayan yiyecek veya başka somut geçim araçları için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Somut yiyecek ve geçim aracı değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin belirli bir geçim aracını yeterli bulup onunla yaşamını sürdürmesi bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eldeki sınırlı araçla yetinme eylemini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, konuşanın amaçladığı anlamı açık ve etkili sözle karşı tarafa ulaştırabilmesini doğrudan tanımlar. Nitelik hem konuşana hem de bu niteliği taşıyan söze yüklenebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sözlü anlatım yetkinliğiyle sınırlıdır; genel kalite veya iletinin fiziksel aktarımı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Konuşanın anlatım yetkinliği ile bu yetkinliği gösteren söz kalıbı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Konuşanın amaçladığı anlamı açık, düzgün ve etkili sözle karşı tarafa ulaştırma yetkinliği; aynı nitelik bunu gerçekleştiren söz için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Konuşan kişi, anlatmak istediği anlamı açık ve etkili biçimde karşı tarafa ulaştırır.
Bu anlatım yetkinliğini taşıyan kişi, dili güçlü ve amacını gerçekleştiren bir konuşmacı olarak nitelenir.
Söz de anlatılmak isteneni açık ve etkili biçimde ilettiğinde aynı nitelikle anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, konuşanın amacını söz aracılığıyla ulaştıran güçlü anlatımı hem bir kişi yetkinliği hem de söz niteliği olarak sunar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yüksek kaliteyi değil, bir işte bütün gücü kullanıp eksik bırakmamayı ve pekiştirmenin son sınırına varmasını da kapsar. Bu nedenle dal, kalite başlığıyla sınırlanmayıp bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi erişilebilecek en ileri dereceye götürme çevresinde yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yüksek kalite bu dalın yalnızca bir görünümüdür; çekirdek, ilgili ölçekte en ileri dereceye erişmedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yüksek nitelikli şey, çabada eksik bırakmama ve son derecedeki pekiştirme ayrı kalıplar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye götürmek ya da o derecede olmak. Yüksek nitelik, bütün gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve en güçlü pekiştirme bunun ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir ölçekte ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye erişme ortak anlam çekirdeğidir.
Bir şey nitelik bakımından çok iyi ve yetkin bir dereceye ulaşmış olabilir.
Bir işi yapan kişi bütün gücünü kullanır ve işi eksik bırakmaz.
Bir buyruk veya ant, tamamlanma ya da pekiştirme bakımından son dereceye ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı, yüksek nitelik, tüm gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve tamamlanmış pekiştirme kullanımlarını bir derecenin sonuna erişme ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi ulaşılabilir en ileri dereceye götürme
concept_gloss.applicability: Nitelik, çaba ve pekiştirme alanlarının her birinde ortak olan son dereceye erişme yapısını temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: En ileri dereceyi, yetkin niteliği, eksik bırakmayan çabayı ve güçlü pekiştirmeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak amacıyla dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması biçimindeki özgül hareketi doğrudan verir. Anlam atın hızlı olması değil, binicinin hızı artırmaya yönelik dizgin hareketidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca binici, dizgin hareketi ve koşuyu artırma amacı birlikte bulunduğunda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım biniciye bağlı at ve dizgin kalıbıyla sınırlıdır; genel koşma, hızlanma veya bir yere varma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Binicinin, atın koşusunu hızlandırmak için dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması.

facets.statement: Eylemi yapan binicidir ve hareket dizgini tutan elle gerçekleştirilir.
Elin ve dizginin ileri verilmesindeki amaç atın koşusunu artırmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, binicinin dizgini tutan elini ileri vererek atın koşusunu artırmaya çalıştığı özgül binicilik hareketinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca binicinin atın koşusunu artırma amacıyla yaptığı belirli dizgin hareketini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Biniciyi, dizgin hareketini ve atı hızlandırma amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak için elini ve dizgini ileri uzattığı sahnede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Araç olan dizgini, binicinin hareketini ve hızlandırma amacını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: binicinin atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri vermesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koşuyu artırma isteği belirli bir el ve dizgin hareketiyle gerçekleştirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atı koşmaya yöneltme, dizgin hareketi olmadan da genel bir isteme eylemi olarak anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi atın koşmasını veya daha hızlı koşmasını ister.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının ayırt edici yanı dizgini tutan eli ileri uzatmaktır; komşu dal atın koşusunu istemeyi daha genel biçimde verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Binicinin atı hızlandırmak amacıyla yaptığı dizgin hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atın, başka bir hayvanın veya binicinin gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşusunu ve yarışmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal atın koşusu ve hızının artması sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hızı doğurmaya yönelik binici hareketidir; komşu dal ise hayvanın veya binicinin hızlı koşma durumudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dizgini ileri verme hareketinin amacı atın koşusunu artırmaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Binek hayvanının yürüyüşe yüklenmesini ve güçlü, hızlı koşma biçimini doğrudan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal binek hayvanının hareketi ve hızlanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta binicinin araca yaptığı müdahale, komşuda ise hayvanın kendi yürüyüş veya koşu biçimi çekirdektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dizgin hareketini koşuyu isteme ve gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşudan ayıran üç ilişki seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولهم بلغ الفارس إذا مد يده بعنان فرسه ليزيد في عدوه أو جريه
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق بلوغ المكان ولا إبلاغ الرسالة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını belirli bir kalıp içinde anlatır. Bu, genel güçlük adı veya hastalığın kendisi değil, olumsuz durumun kişiyi giderek daha şiddetli biçimde sıkıştırmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde şiddetlenmesi kalıbıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yokluk veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını bildiren kalıba bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşıp onu iyice sıkıştırması.

facets.statement: Olumsuz durum, belirli bir kimseyi etkileyerek önceki düzeyinden daha ağır hale gelir.
Ağırlaşan durum yokluk ya da hastalık olarak belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişinin üzerinde şiddetlenip ağırlaşması biçimindeki kalıplaşmış kullanımda birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: yokluk veya hastalığın kişiyi iyice sıkıştırması
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumsuz durumun yalnızca bulunmasını değil, belirli kişi üzerinde ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Yokluk veya hastalığı, etkilenen kişiyi ve şiddetlenme sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişiyi giderek daha ağır biçimde etkilediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yönelen etkiyi ve durumun şiddetlenmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yokluğun veya hastalığın kişinin üzerinde ağırlaşması

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde giderek ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, daralma, ağrı ve maddi ya da bedensel güçlüğü genel adlar olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi ağır bir sıkıntı veya bedensel zorluk yaşar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı durumun kişi üzerinde şiddetlenme sürecidir; komşu dal sıkıntı ve güçlüğün kendisini daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hastalığın kişi üzerinde daha da ağırlaşmasını anlatır ve yokluğu da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sağlıklı ve dengeli durumdan çıkmayı, bedensel bozukluğu ve hastalık halini genel olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hastalık, iki dalın kesiştiği durum alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında hastalık zaten vardır ve şiddetlenir; komşu dal hastalık durumunun kendisini ve sağlıktan sapmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiddetin yokluk veya hastalık tarafından belirli kişiye yönelmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağır darbe, ateşli hastalık, zarar ve genel güçlük gibi çok çeşitli şiddetli durumları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişiyi zorlayan durumun şiddeti öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı iki belirli durumun ağırlaşma kalıbıdır; komşu dal farklı neden ve olaylardaki şiddeti geniş bir ad alanı olarak verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; şiddetlenme sürecini genel sıkıntıdan, hastalıktan ve geniş zarar alanından ayıran üç ilişki yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, fakat olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış sözü destekler. Bu anlam sıradan duyma ya da haber ulaştırma değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal üzücü olay karşısındaki korunma dileğiyle sınırlıdır; yalın işitme veya haber alma anlamına açılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıplaşmış korunma dileği dalın çekirdeğidir; üzücü haber adı ayrı bir sözlük birimi olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, onun konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış söz.

facets.statement: Konuşan, üzücü olayın benzerinden yalnızca uzaktan haber almayı kabul eder.
Aynı olayın kendilerine ulaşmaması veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmaması dilenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, üzücü olayın yalnızca duyulmasıyla bağlantılı kalıplaşmış korunma dileğini verir; bir yorum olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini, diğer yorum ise işitilip tamamlanmamasını korur.

concept_gloss.text: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalmayı dileme
concept_gloss.applicability: Üzücü bir olay karşısında benzerinin konuşanlara erişmemesi veya gerçekleşmemesi dileğini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyma ile olaydan korunma dileğini aynı kalıpta birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzücü bir olay duyulduğunda aynı durumun konuşanların başına gelmemesi dilenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaktan duyma ile olaydan korunma karşıtlığını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanı üzen ve kendisine ulaşan haber
duyalım ama başımıza gelmesin dileği

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalma dileği
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da üzücü olayın duyulmasını, fakat konuşana erişmemesini dileyen aynı kalıplaşmış sözü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kaynak kartlarında kurucu koşul veya kapsam farkı görünmez; iki dal aynı korunma dileğini aynı sınırlarla verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üzücü olayın yalnızca duyulması ve konuşanlara erişmemesi istenir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tökezleyen veya kötü bir olay yaşayan muhatap için doğrudan esenlik dileğinde bulunulur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kötü bir olay karşısında zarar görmeme dileğini sözle ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı olayı uzakta tutmaya yönelik birinci çoğul korunma sözüdür; komşu dal olayla karşılaşmış muhataba yöneltilen esenlik dileğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zararın gerçekleşmemesi sözlü bir dilek olarak ifade edilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir nesne, düşman veya yaptırım etkin bir araçla geri çevrilir ya da engellenir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da istenmeyen şeyin kişiye ulaşmaması amaçlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı bir korunma dileğidir ve etkin müdahale içermez; komşu dal zararı fiilen geri çevirme veya önleme eylemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, çoğul biçimi bir kimseyi çekiştirip başkasına, özellikle etkili bir makama bildiren kötüleyici sözler anlamında tanımlar. Bu kullanım nötr ileti aktarımından ve sıradan haber vermeden ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kanıtlanan yalın çoğul biçimin kötüleyici bildirim anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve kalıp dışı anlam eklemez.

facets.statement: Bir kişi hakkında kötüleyici bildirimler veya çekiştirmeler başkasına aktarılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında bildirim yoluyla kişiye zarar verme yönelimi belirgindir; komşu dal konuşmayı toplama ve çevreye yayma sürecini merkez alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, özel bir ad biçimini insanın veya topluluğun başına inen ağır ve yıkıcı büyük olay anlamında verir; ayrıca bu olayın konuşanların başına gelmesini anlatan bir kalıp tanıklar. Dal genel güçlükten daha ağır bir olay adıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanın veya topluluğun başına gelen olumsuz olayı kapsayabilir.
